# SynthyBoy - parameters

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-params-doc.py from docs/params.json (build/tools/paramdump/synthyboy_paramdump). Do not edit. -->

The parameter table is our own design (`core/src/param_table.cpp`, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 2.2 and 5.1): keys are lowercase and dotted, ranges are in our units (Hz, ms, dB, cents, semitones, percent, degrees, beats) and are inside what the engines can do. `docs/params.json` is the same table for machines (Kick's own UI reads it). State format version 4 stores every parameter by key (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 5.2).

**2637 parameters.** Column *own engine*: yes = the own engine (`core/engine-own`, the engine of iOS builds) acts on the parameter; every parameter is stored, saved and read back by every engine, the engine of the Vital-derived DSP (`core/engine-vital`) acts on all of them.

## Default patch

A clean, basic saw patch: oscillator 1 on (built-in Saw, one voice, centred, level 50 %), filter 1 on (Digital model, low-pass, 12 kHz, 20 % resonance), envelope 1 with a 5 ms attack, 400 ms decay to 100 % sustain and 200 ms release, master volume -12 dB, polyphony 16, no effects, all 64 modulation slots empty. Oscillators 2 and 3, the noise and the other filters are off. Written from the table's defaults, not from any preset.

## Parameters by section

Modulation: parameters marked *mod* can be the destination of a modulation slot. A slot's amount (-100 .. 100 %) is a fraction of the destination's range **in the engine's own scale** (for the filter cutoff that is the whole keyboard range in semitones, not Hz). A slot whose wiring would close a loop (its source depends on its destination, for example one LFO modulating the rate of another that modulates the first) stays unwired, because the engine would have to allocate on the audio thread to build it.

### Mod Matrix

| Key | Name | Range | Default | Group | Mod | Own engine |
|-----|------|-------|---------|-------|-----|------------|
| `modNN.source` | Mod NN Source (NN = 01 .. 64) | 0 None, 1..57 sources (list below) | None | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 |  |  |
| `modNN.destination` | Mod NN Destination (NN = 01 .. 64) | 0 None, 1..1248 destinations (list below) | None | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 |  |  |
| `modNN.amount` | Mod NN Amount (NN = 01 .. 64) | -100 .. 100 % | 0 % | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 | mod |  |
| `modNN.power` | Mod NN Curve (NN = 01 .. 64) | -10 .. 10 | 0 | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 |  |  |
| `modNN.bipolar` | Mod NN Bipolar (NN = 01 .. 64) | 0 Off, 1 On | Off | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 |  |  |
| `modNN.stereo` | Mod NN Stereo (NN = 01 .. 64) | 0 Off, 1 On | Off | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 |  |  |
| `modNN.bypass` | Mod NN Bypass (NN = 01 .. 64) | 0 Off, 1 On | Off | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 |  |  |
| `modNN.aux_source` | Mod NN Aux Source (NN = 01 .. 64) | 0 None, 1..57 sources (list below) | None | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 |  |  |
| `modNN.aux_inv` | Mod NN Aux Invert (NN = 01 .. 64) | 0 Off, 1 On | Off | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 |  |  |
| `modNN.aux_power` | Mod NN Aux Curve (NN = 01 .. 64) | -10 .. 10 | 0 | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 |  |  |
| `modNN.aux_output` | Mod NN Output Scale (NN = 01 .. 64) | 0 .. 200 % | 100 % | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 |  |  |
| `modNN.rise` | Mod NN Rise (NN = 01 .. 64) | 0 .. 5000 ms (skew 0.300000012) | 0 ms | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 | mod |  |
| `modNN.fall` | Mod NN Fall (NN = 01 .. 64) | 0 .. 5000 ms (skew 0.300000012) | 0 ms | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 | mod |  |
| `modNN.delay` | Mod NN Delay (NN = 01 .. 64) | 0 .. 4000 ms (skew 0.400000006) | 0 ms | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 | mod |  |
| `modNN.delay_beats` | Mod NN Delay (Beats) (NN = 01 .. 64) | 0 .. 8 beats (skew 0.400000006) | 0 beats | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 | mod |  |
| `modNN.delay_sync` | Mod NN Delay Tempo Sync (NN = 01 .. 64) | 0 Off, 1 On | Off | Mod Matrix / Slot 01 |  |  |

The matrix has %d identical slots `mod01` .. `mod64` (only the first is listed). A slot with source *None* or destination *None* does nothing. *Bipolar* centres a 0..1 source around zero, *Stereo* inverts the amount in the right channel, *Bypass* mutes the slot, *Curve* bends the source (negative = fast start, positive = slow start).

## Built-in wavetables and LFO shapes

* `wavetable (all instances)`: 0 Sine, 1 Saw, 2 Square, 3 Triangle, 4 Pulse 25%, 5 Saw to Square, 6 Sine to Saw, 7 Harmonic Series, 8 Odd Harmonics, 9 Formant Sweep, 10 FM Sweep, 11 PWM Sweep, 12 Bell Partials, 13 Preset table, 14 Saw Down
* `shape (all instances)`: 0 Sine, 1 Triangle, 2 Saw Up, 3 Saw Down, 4 Square, 5 Pulse 25%, 6 Steps Up, 7 Steps Down, 8 Random Steps, 9 Exp Up, 10 Exp Down, 11 Half Sine, 12 Custom

They are generated by code in the engine adapter (no file, no preset, no third-party content). The own engine plays Sine for entry 0 and Saw for every other entry.

## Quality tiers

A tier only caps or bypasses (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 3.6); parameter values are never changed.

| | Low | Medium | High |
|-|-----|--------|------|
| Max voices | 8 | 16 | 32 |
| Max unison voices per oscillator | 4 | 8 | 16 |
| Oversampling | 1x | 2x | 2x |
| Wavetable frame interpolation | linear | linear | spectral |
| Effects bypassed | reverb, flanger | none | none |

## Not exposed

* **Sample oscillator**: pending (Phase 4): it needs content packs (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 6). The engine has one; the noise oscillator above is its built-in white noise.
* **Free-form LFO shapes / wavetable editing**: pending (Phase 5, UI): LFOs use the built-in shape list and oscillators the built-in wavetables; there is no editor and no import yet.
* **Tuning root (A4 reference), tuning tables**: not exposed: the engine's tuning object is a scale/keyboard-map loader (no reference frequency); this build plays 12-tone equal temperament at A4 = 440 Hz.
* **Oscillator MIDI tracking (fixed pitch), transpose quantize**: not exposed: not part of the feature list; the engine has them.
* **Spectral unison switch**: not exposed: always on (the engine default).
* **Per-oscillator smooth interpolation switch**: not a parameter: it is the quality tier's wavetable interpolation (linear on Low and Medium, spectral on High).
* **Oversampling**: the quality tier's (1x on Low, 2x otherwise); `quality.oversample_4x` raises it to 4x on any tier.
* **Stereo mode / routing, view settings, MPE, bypass, tempo control**: not exposed: host / UI business, not sound design.
* **Mod sources lift, slide, stereo, note-in-octave**: not exposed: the event contract has no lift/slide and the matrix list is the one of docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 3.5.
* **Line-map curve of a modulation slot**: not exposed: free-form curve editing (the slot keeps the linear map); the 'curve' parameter (power) is exposed.
* **Voice priority / override, keytracked portamento options beyond the four listed**: voice priority is `master.voice.steal_priority` (oldest / lowest / newest); voice override stays 'kill'.
